description: Binary interaction parameters k_ij, one entry per (species pair, equation of state), symmetric in the two ids. An absent pair means k_ij = 0, the default of every mixing rule in the library. The table ships EMPTY on purpose: no value may be added without a documented source (e.g. Knapp et al. 1982, DECHEMA Chemistry Data Series) and the temperature range it was fitted over. Entry form: {"species1": "CO2", "species2": "N2", "eos": "PengRobinson", "kij": 0.0, "tMinK": 0.0, "tMaxK": 0.0, "source": "..."}.
